name: Jian Hao Lim
bio:
Jian Hao discovered his passion for motorsport through online racing simulations during his university days. After graduating with a degree in Information Technology, he initially pursued a career in corporate IT, but always felt a pull towards the adrenaline-fueled world of racing. He eventually transitioned into motorsport by volunteering his IT skills at local racing events, gaining valuable hands-on experience.

As an IT Systems Manager, Jian Hao believes in a proactive and adaptable approach. He is driven to create robust and innovative IT solutions that can give his team a competitive edge. He is especially interested in data analytics and how it can be used to optimize race strategies and improve vehicle performance. Despite being relatively new to the professional side of motorsport, Jian Hao's ambition and eagerness to learn make him a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jian Hao is of average height with a slightly stocky build, always impeccably dressed in business casual attire.
